{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/node/mempool_args.cpp and test/functional/mempool_cluster.py to validate minimum cluster limits and handle negated limits at startup.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents an assertion crash in TxGraph on the first mempool transaction when -nolimitclustercount is passed. This eliminates an unexpected crash condition during startup configuration for cluster mempool parameters."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/bitcoin-cli.cpp and fixes -norpcpassword handling affecting RPC server authentication.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects an authentication issue where -norpcpassword set the RPC password to \"0\" instead of falling back to cookie authentication. It also updates bitcoin-cli argument handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and src/init.cpp to introduce NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and overhaul negated option parsing.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes hazardous side effects across the node's argument parsing infrastructure when configuration options are negated. Without this, options like -notorcontrol connect to 0.0.0.0:9051 and notify hooks attempt to execute a binary named \"0\"."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/wallet/init.cpp, src/wallet/load.cpp, and src/wallet/walletutil.cpp mechanically adopt the new argument negation flags for wallet options.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not alter wallet logic or interfaces. Wallet changes merely follow the common argument manager updates for options like -nowalletnotify and -nosigner."
    }
  ],

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Changes src/node/mempool_args.cpp and test/functional/mempool_cluster.py to validate minimum cluster limits and handle negated limits at startup.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion crash in TxGraph on the first mempool transaction when -nolimitclustercount is passed. This eliminates an unexpected crash condition during startup configuration for cluster mempool parameters.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes src/bitcoin-cli.cpp and fixes -norpcpassword handling affecting RPC server authentication.
categories.rationale: Corrects an authentication issue where -norpcpassword set the RPC password to "0" instead of falling back to cookie authentication. It also updates bitcoin-cli argument handling.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and src/init.cpp to introduce NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and overhaul negated option parsing.
categories.rationale: Fixes hazardous side effects across the node's argument parsing infrastructure when configuration options are negated. Without this, options like -notorcontrol connect to 0.0.0.0:9051 and notify hooks attempt to execute a binary named "0".

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Edits to src/wallet/init.cpp, src/wallet/load.cpp, and src/wallet/walletutil.cpp mechanically adopt the new argument negation flags for wallet options.
categories.rationale: The PR does not alter wallet logic or interfaces. Wallet changes merely follow the common argument manager updates for options like -nowalletnotify and -nosigner.
